name: Minorca Blue Umbrella
original_name: ミノルカブルー・アンブレラ
source:
On another usual rainy day, with anticipation.
I found myself holding my breath without thinking.
I mixed a sigh into the sound of turning pages.

Even without doing that, would the sound of the rain have drowned it out for me?
